plain.text: Isaac called Jacob, blessed him, and told him not to marry a Canaanite woman, but to go to Paddan Aram and marry one of Laban's daughters. He prayed that God Almighty would bless him and give him the blessing of Abraham.
Esau saw that his father did not like Canaanite women, so he went to Ishmael's family and married Mahalath, Ishmael's daughter, in addition to the wives he had.

Jacob left Beersheba for Haran. At sunset he stopped for the night, put a stone under his head and lay down to sleep. He dreamed of a stairway resting on the earth, with its top reaching to heaven, and the angels of God going up and down on it. The LORD stood above it and said, "I am the LORD, the God of your father Abraham and the God of Isaac. I will give you and your descendants the land on which you are lying. All the families of the earth will be blessed through you and your offspring. I am with you and will watch over you wherever you go, and I will bring you back. I will not leave you until I have done what I have promised." Jacob woke and thought, "Surely the LORD is in this place, and I was not aware of it." He was afraid: "This is none other than the house of God; this is the gate of heaven."

Early in the morning Jacob set up the stone as a pillar and poured oil on it. He called the place Bethel ("house of God"). He made a vow: if God would be with him, provide food and clothing, and bring him back safely, then the LORD would be his God, and he would give God a tenth of all he received.

summary.bigIdea: Running away from home, Jacob meets God in a dream and receives God's promise to be with him wherever he goes.
points: Jacob leaves home, alone, after deceiving his family.
He dreams of a stairway to heaven, and God repeats the promise to Abraham.
"Surely the LORD is in this place, and I was unaware of it."
summary.reflection: Jacob met God when he least expected it. Have you ever sensed God was with you in an unexpected place?
